name: Primo, the Unbounded
oracle_text:
Trample
Primo enters with twice X +1/+1 counters on it.
Whenever one or more creatures you control with base power 0 deal combat damage to a player, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more creatures you control with base power 0 deal combat damage to a player, create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.

needs.what: a value on a batched creatures_deal_combat_damage trigger that is the total combat damage the matching (filtered) damagers dealt to the player(s) in that batch -- 'equal to the damage dealt' -- so add_counters on the created token can read it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The CREATURES_DEALT_COMBAT_DAMAGE event fired by combat._fire_damage_batch carries damagers, damaged, damaged_battles and hits (oid lists only), no damage amounts, so the `amount`/`damage` bindings are absent; value_keys has damage_taken_this_turn/max_damage_taken_this_turn (per-player turn totals, not this batch from these creatures). Per-creature deals_combat_damage_to_player binds amount but fires once per creature, which is not 'one or more ... create a token' (one token for the batch).

needs.what: a trigger filter key 'base_power' on creatures_deal_combat_damage matching creatures whose base (printed/copiable, pre-counters/buffs) power is 0
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys has `power` (current power) but not `base_power`; base_power appears only in selector_keys, and a creature with base power 0 and +1/+1 counters has nonzero current power, which is exactly the case this card cares about.
